'''''Goeppertia rufibarba''''' (syn. ''Calathea rufibarba''), the '''furry feather''' or '''velvet calathea''', is a species of flowering plant in the [[Marantaceae]] [[Family (taxonomy)|family]], native to Bahia state of northeastern Brazil.<ref name="60461321-2" >{{cite POWO |id=0461321-2 |title=''Goeppertia rufibarba'' (Fenzl) Borchs. & S.Suárez }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://wcsp.science.kew.org/namedetail.do?name_id=494199 |title=''Goeppertia rufibarba'' |work=World Checklist of Selected Plant Families}}</ref><ref name="catalogue">{{cite web |url=http://www.catalogueoflife.org/annual-checklist/2010/details/species/id/7253642 |title=Species details |work=Catalogue of Life: 2010 Annual Checklist}}</ref> The plant's common names are due to its fuzzy, fur-like underleaf texture, which is unusual in its genus.<ref>{{citation |title=Kew Bulletin, Volume 11 |work=[[Kew Bulletin]] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=uyNXAAAAMAAJ |year=1897 |publisher=H.M. Stationery Office |page=403}}</ref><ref name="Steinkopf">{{cite book |author=Lisa Eldred Steinkopf |title=Houseplants: The Complete Guide to Choosing, Growing, and Caring for Indoor Plants |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=XMA2DwAAQBAJ |date=23 October 2017 |publisher=Cool Springs Press |isbn=978-1-59186-690-9 |page=261}}</ref> Furthermore, the specific epithet ''rufibarba'' comes from the Latin {{lang|la|rufus}} 'red' and {{lang|la|barba}} 'beard'.<ref name="NCSU">{{cite web |title=Goeppertia rufibarba |url=https://plants.ces.ncsu.edu/plants/goeppertia-rufibarba/ |website=North Carolina Extension Gardener Plant Toolbox |publisher=NC State University |access-date=30 May 2026}}</ref>

Common as a houseplant, the species requires warm temperatures, shade, and humidity to thrive, and may produce small yellow flowers.<ref>{{cite book |author=DK |title=How to Grow Practically Everything |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=gmAuHkA7KjgC |date=1 March 2010 |publisher=DK Publishing |isbn=978-0-7566-7001-6 |page=381}}</ref><ref>{{citation |title=Curtis's Botanical Magazine, Volume 123 |author=Sir William Jackson Hooker |work=[[Curtis's Botanical Magazine]] |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=rVBNAAAAYAAJ |year=1897 |publisher=Academic Press}}</ref> It has gained the [[Royal Horticultural Society]]'s [[Award of Garden Merit]].<ref>{{cite web |title=''Goeppertia rufibarba'' |url=https://www.rhs.org.uk/Plants/357240/Goeppertia-rufibarba/Details |date=2021 |publisher=The Royal Horticultural Society |access-date=8 May 2021 }}</ref>
